En cuanto al riego, la regla de oro es comprobar la tierra: mete un dedo unos 2 o 3 centímetros; si la notas seca, es hora de regar. Un buen drenaje es vital, así que asegúrate de que tus macetas tienen 1 o 2 agujeros para evitar el encharcamiento, que es la causa de muerte de 7 de cada 10 plantas de interior.

text_en_raw: To successfully care for indoor plants, a beginner should start with 3 or 4 resilient plants, such as pothos or snake plants. It's crucial to research the specific needs of each species, paying attention to 2 key factors: light and watering. Most indoor plants need bright, indirect light; avoid direct sun exposure, which could burn their leaves in just 5 or 6 hours. Regarding watering, the golden rule is to check the soil: stick a finger about 2 or 3 centimeters deep; if you feel it's dry, it's time to water. Good drainage is vital, so make sure your pots have 1 or 2 holes to prevent waterlogging, which is the cause of death for 7 out of 10 indoor plants.

text_en_raw: About 5 years ago, I decided to drastically reduce food waste in my home, and the change has been significant. Before, it was normal to throw away 2 or 3 containers of expired yogurt or let 4 bananas turn black in the fruit bowl. The 1st step was to plan weekly menus 7 days in advance, buying only what was necessary for those specific meals. Another measure was to cook in smaller quantities, because there were only 2 people at home and often 6 servings of stew were left over and ended up in the trash. Now, leftovers are used—sometimes the next day—in a new recipe, or they're frozen for another occasion; I've even kept food for up to 15 days! With this new dynamic, we've not only saved money, but I also feel enormous personal satisfaction in contributing a little to reducing the global problem of food waste.

text_es: Hacer conservas de tomate es un método excelente para preservar el sabor del verano y disfrutar de esta fruta versátil durante todo el año. El proceso comienza seleccionando tomates maduros y de buena calidad, idealmente recogidos hace no más de 2 días. Después de lavarlos, se suelen escaldar en agua hirviendo durante 1 o 2 minutos para pelarlos fácilmente; este paso facilita una textura más suave en la conserva final. Luego, se trituran o cortan los tomates, se cocinan a fuego lento durante unos 10 o 15 minutos para concentrar los sabores y se añade sal al gusto —algunas recetas incorporan 1 o 2 hojas de albahaca para un toque aromático—. Finalmente, la mezcla se introduce en frascos esterilizados, se cierran herméticamente y se someten a un baño maría durante aproximadamente 20 minutos para asegurar la correcta conservación y eliminar posibles bacterias, lo que permite almacenarlos por 6 meses o más en un lugar fresco y oscuro.

text_en_raw: Making tomato preserves is an excellent method to preserve the taste of summer and enjoy this versatile fruit all year round. The process begins by selecting ripe, good-quality tomatoes, ideally picked no more than 2 days ago. After washing them, they are usually blanched in boiling water for 1 or 2 minutes to peel them easily; this step facilitates a smoother texture in the final preserve. Then, the tomatoes are crushed or chopped, simmered for about 10 or 15 minutes to concentrate the flavors, and salt is added to taste—some recipes incorporate 1 or 2 basil leaves for an aromatic touch. Finally, the mixture is placed in sterilized jars, sealed tightly, and subjected to a water bath for approximately 20 minutes to ensure proper preservation and eliminate possible bacteria, which allows them to be stored for 6 months or more in a cool, dark place.

text_en_raw: If you're starting out making canned tomatoes, it's crucial to select 10 ripe tomatoes in perfect condition. Wash them well and blanch each one for about 2 minutes in boiling water to peel them easily; 3 or 4 small cuts will be enough. Cook them over low heat for at least 15 minutes, adding salt, and if you like, 1 clove of garlic and 2 fresh basil leaves to enhance the flavor. Sterilize the glass jars for 10 minutes, fill them with the still-hot tomato, leaving 1 cm of space at the top, and seal them tightly. Finally, boil the filled jars for 20 minutes to ensure preservation, and you'll have a delicious homemade product.

text_en_raw: To prepare a successful picnic, consider these 5 key points. 1st, choose a pleasant place with at least 2 natural shade options. 2nd, select foods that are easy to transport and don't need constant refrigeration for more than 3 or 4 hours; pasta or couscous salads are excellent, and for dessert, 6 individual muffins are a good idea. 3rd, don't forget the drinks; 1 or 2 thermoses with cold water and juices will be enough for 7 people. 4th, bring comfortable blankets to sit on and some small cushions, perhaps 3 or 4. 5th, always have a bag for waste and leave everything clean; this way, nature will be happy, and you'll want to repeat the experience.

text_en_raw: Fixing a leaky faucet is a common task that often requires only 5 simple steps and can save 10 liters of water per day. Generally, the problem lies in a worn washer or the faucet's cartridge. To begin, it's crucial to turn off the water shut-off valve—there are usually 2 in the bathroom—to prevent spills. Then, with a wrench or screwdriver, the faucet is disassembled following the manufacturer's instructions, which can take 7 minutes. Once open, the washer or cartridge is inspected; if they are damaged, they are replaced with new parts that cost between 3 and 8 euros. Finally, the faucet is reassembled, and the water supply is turned on to verify that there are no longer any leaks.

text_en_raw: If you're a beginner and your faucet is dripping, don't panic, with 3 basic tools and 15 minutes you can fix it. 1st, turn off the main stopcock to prevent flooding; you'll find it under the sink or in the bathroom. Gather 2 cloths and an adjustable wrench—or 1 screwdriver if it's a lever type—to have everything at hand. Carefully disassemble the trim and the handle to access the cartridge or the O-rings, which are the parts that usually fail. Often, the problem is solved by replacing 1 or 2 worn rubber gaskets, which you can buy for about 5 euros at any hardware store. When reassembling, tighten firmly, but don't overdo it, and then open the stopcock to check that the dripping has stopped.

text_es: Cultivar hierbas aromáticas en casa es una práctica gratificante que ofrece 2 beneficios clave: frescura y sabor para la cocina. Para empezar, solo se necesitan 3 elementos básicos: semillas o plántulas, tierra de calidad y una maceta con 1 o 2 orificios de drenaje. La exposición solar es crucial; la mayoría requiere un mínimo de 5 o 6 horas de luz solar directa al día. El riego debe ser regular, pero sin encharcar, y es aconsejable añadir un fertilizante orgánico cada 7 u 8 semanas durante la época de crecimiento. Muchas hierbas, como la albahaca o el romero, crecen bien en contenedores, lo que permite moverlas fácilmente si las condiciones climáticas cambian de forma brusca o inesperada. Con solo 4 o 5 cuidados básicos, se puede disfrutar de un pequeño jardín de aromas y sabores que enriquecerá cualquier plato.

text_en_raw: Cultivating aromatic herbs at home is a rewarding practice that offers 2 key benefits: freshness and flavor for cooking. With just 4 or 5 basic cares, you can enjoy a small garden of aromas and flavors that will enrich any dish.

Las varillas se ensamblan y se insertan por las fundas de la tienda, dándole su estructura básica. Tras levantarla, se fijan las esquinas al suelo con un mínimo de 4 piquetas, aunque lo más recomendable son 6 o incluso 8, para asegurar la estabilidad con vientos de hasta 15 km/h. Finalmente, se coloca el doble techo si la tienda lo incluye —algo habitual en modelos de 3 o 4 estaciones—, ofreciendo una capa extra de protección contra la lluvia y el frío.

text_es: Para cocinar un arroz perfecto, la proporción de agua y arroz es crucial, generalmente 2 partes de agua por cada 1 de arroz, aunque esto puede variar ligeramente según el tipo de grano. Es fundamental enjuagar el arroz 2 o 3 veces antes de cocinarlo para eliminar el exceso de almidón y evitar que se apelmace. Luego, se sofríe brevemente el arroz en un poco de aceite o mantequilla durante 1 minuto para sellar los granos, lo que ayuda a que queden sueltos. Posteriormente, se añade el agua —o caldo— hirviendo y se sazona al gusto, con 4 gramos de sal por cada 100 gramos de arroz como referencia. Una vez que rompa a hervir de nuevo, se baja el fuego al mínimo, se tapa y se cocina durante unos 15 a 18 minutos. Finalmente, se deja reposar el arroz tapado fuera del fuego durante 5 minutos antes de servirlo para que absorba el vapor restante y los granos queden bien separados.

text_en_raw: To cook perfect rice, the ratio of water to rice is crucial, generally 2 parts water for every 1 part rice, although this can vary slightly depending on the type of grain. It's essential to rinse the rice 2 or 3 times before cooking it to remove excess starch and prevent it from clumping. Then, the rice is briefly sautéed in a little oil or butter for 1 minute to seal the grains, which helps them stay loose. Afterward, boiling water—or broth—is added and seasoned to taste, with 4 grams of salt per 100 grams of rice as a reference. Once it boils again, the heat is lowered to a minimum, it's covered, and cooked for about 15 to 18 minutes. Finally, the rice is left to rest, covered, off the heat for 5 minutes before serving so that it absorbs the remaining steam and the grains are well separated.

text_es: Hacer yogur casero es un proceso gratificante que requiere 2 ingredientes principales: leche y un cultivo iniciador (yogur natural previo). 1.º, se calienta 1 litro de leche a 85 °C para eliminar bacterias indeseadas y modificar las proteínas; esto suele llevar 10 minutos a fuego medio. Luego, se deja enfriar a 45 °C, temperatura ideal para el cultivo; se recomienda usar un termómetro para mayor precisión y tardará unos 15 minutos. Una vez fría, se añade 1 cucharada sopera del yogur iniciador y se mezcla bien; esta etapa es crucial para la fermentación. La mezcla se vierte en frascos, se tapa y se mantiene a unos 40-45 °C durante 6 a 8 horas, idealmente en una yogurtera o un horno apagado con la luz encendida. Después de ese tiempo, se refrigera por al menos 3 horas antes de consumir, logrando una textura más firme y un sabor delicioso.

text_en_raw: Making homemade yogurt is a rewarding process that requires 2 main ingredients: milk and a starter culture (previous plain yogurt). 1st, 1 liter of milk is heated to 85 °C to eliminate unwanted bacteria and modify proteins; this usually takes 10 minutes over medium heat. Then, it's allowed to cool to 45 °C, the ideal temperature for the culture; it's recommended to use a thermometer for greater precision, and it will take about 15 minutes. Once cool, 1 tablespoon of the starter yogurt is added and mixed well; this stage is crucial for fermentation. The mixture is poured into jars, covered, and kept at about 40-45 °C for 6 to 8 hours, ideally in a yogurt maker or an oven turned off with the light on. After that time, it's refrigerated for at least 3 hours before consuming, achieving a firmer texture and a delicious flavor.

text_en_raw: To start caring for a rose garden, it's crucial to choose the location well; they need at least 6 hours of direct sun daily to bloom profusely. text_es: Aprender a hacer croquetas es un arte culinario que requiere paciencia y una buena técnica para conseguir una textura perfecta. La base principal es una bechamel cremosa, para la cual se suelen usar 3 ingredientes clave: mantequilla, harina y leche, además del relleno deseado. Se derriten 2 cucharadas de mantequilla en una sartén, se añaden 2 cucharadas de harina y se cocina esta mezcla —el roux— durante 1 o 2 minutos sin dejar de remover. Luego, se incorpora la leche caliente poco a poco, batiendo constantemente para evitar grumos, hasta obtener una consistencia espesa; este proceso puede durar unos 5 a 7 minutos. Una vez fría, la masa se moldea, se reboza en harina, huevo batido y pan rallado, y finalmente se fríen en abundante aceite caliente hasta que estén doradas, lo cual toma 3 o 4 minutos por tanda.

text_en_raw: Learning to make croquettes is a culinary art that requires patience and good technique to achieve a perfect texture. The main base is a creamy béchamel, for which 3 key ingredients are usually used: butter, flour, and milk, in addition to the desired filling. 2 tablespoons of butter are melted in a pan, 2 tablespoons of flour are added, and this mixture—the roux—is cooked for 1 or 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Then, hot milk is incorporated little by little, whisking constantly to avoid lumps, until a thick consistency is obtained; this process can last about 5 to 7 minutes. Once cold, the dough is shaped, coated in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs, and finally fried in plenty of hot oil until golden, which takes 3 or 4 minutes per batch.

Fry them in plenty of hot oil until golden, about 5 minutes, and enjoy this delicacy with your 6 friends.

The next day, with a damp cloth and a plastic spatula, remove the mixture and the ingrained dirt; you might need 7 passes to leave it spotless. Finally, spray a little white vinegar and wipe with another clean cloth to remove any residue and leave a perfect shine.

text_es: Recuerdo la frustración de mis 8 años cuando intentaba aprender a silbar, un arte que parecía inalcanzable. Mis primos, 2 y 3 años mayores que yo, ya lo dominaban y se reían de mis esfuerzos, que solo producían un siseo sin gracia. Pasé 7 tardes enteras frente al espejo, haciendo 5 muecas diferentes, probando todas las posiciones de labios y lengua que se me ocurrían. Mi abuelo me prometió 10 céntimos si lograba silbar una canción, y esa zanahoria extra me dio el empujón final. Un día, mientras estaba solo en el jardín, después de quizás 15 intentos más, salió un sonido claro y agudo, una nota perfecta. ¡Fue la 1.ª vez! La alegría fue inmensa, y corrí a mostrarle a mi abuelo mi nueva habilidad.

verify_en.notes: The phrase '2, and 3 years older' should be '2 and 3 years older' (punctuation error), but the main style violation is '1st time' which uses ordinal notation instead of digit form; should be '1st' is acceptable but 'the 1st' follows NAT style correctly as a digit.

text_en_raw: I remember the frustration of my 8-year-old self when I was trying to learn to whistle, an art that seemed unattainable. My cousins, 2 and 3 years older than me, already mastered it and laughed at my efforts, which only produced a graceless hiss. I spent 7 entire afternoons in front of the mirror, making 5 different faces, trying all the lip and tongue positions I could think of. My grandfather promised me 10 cents if I could whistle a song, and that extra carrot gave me the final push. One day, while I was alone in the garden, after perhaps 15 more attempts, a clear, sharp sound came out, a perfect note. It was the 1st time! The joy was immense, and I ran to show my grandfather my new skill.

text_es: Para aprender a silbar, la clave está en la paciencia y la práctica constante, sin prisa. Empieza humedeciendo tus labios y formándolos como si fueras a dar un beso, dejando una pequeña abertura de 2 o 3 milímetros. Luego, coloca tu lengua ligeramente curvada hacia arriba, tocando el paladar detrás de tus dientes frontales. Sopla suavemente; al principio, solo escucharás aire, pero con 4 o 5 intentos notarás un sonido. Varía la fuerza y la posición de la lengua y los labios; hay 6 o 7 formas diferentes de silbar, así que experimenta con cada una hasta encontrar la que te resulte más cómoda. Dedica al menos 10 minutos cada día durante 15 días, y verás cómo el sonido mejora considerablemente.

verify_en.notes: The abbreviation '1st' is not standard English; should be 'first' or 'at first'. This violates fluency and style consistency (1st is neither NAT nor ALT for the num_words family).

text_en_raw: To learn to whistle, the key is patience and constant practice, without rushing. Start by moistening your lips and forming them as if you were going to kiss, leaving a small opening of 2 or 3 millimeters. Then, place your tongue slightly curved upward, touching the roof of your mouth behind your front teeth. Blow gently; at first, you'll only hear air, but with 4 or 5 attempts you'll notice a sound. Vary the force and position of your tongue and lips; there are 6 or 7 different ways to whistle, so experiment with each one until you find the one that's most comfortable for you. Dedicate at least 10 minutes each day for 15 days, and you'll see how the sound improves considerably.

text_es: Cuidar un olivo en maceta requiere atención específica para asegurar su correcto desarrollo. 1.º, es crucial seleccionar una maceta con al menos 40 cm de diámetro y con buenos agujeros de drenaje para evitar el encharcamiento, que podría pudrir las raíces. Se recomienda usar un sustrato ligero y bien drenado, idealmente con un 10 % de arena o perlita, y regar cada 3 o 4 días durante los meses cálidos, reduciendo la frecuencia a 1 o 2 veces por semana en invierno, asegurando que las 2-3 1.as pulgadas de tierra estén secas antes de volver a regar. Un olivo necesita un mínimo de 6 horas diarias de luz solar directa para fructificar y crecer sano, por lo que su ubicación es clave. La poda se realiza a finales de invierno o principios de primavera para darle forma y eliminar ramas secas o enfermas, con un máximo de 5-6 ramas principales. Además, un abonado cada 2 meses durante la época de crecimiento con un fertilizante equilibrado lo mantendrá fuerte.

verify_en.notes: The ordinal '1st' appears twice in spelled-out form ('1st' is not a digit representation); all cardinal numbers 2-20 are correctly in NAT style (digits), but ordinals should follow the same family rule and '1st' should be '1st' in digit form per NAT convention.

text_en_raw: Caring for a potted olive tree requires specific attention to ensure its proper development. 1st, it's crucial to select a pot with at least 40 cm in diameter and with good drainage holes to prevent waterlogging, which could rot the roots. It's recommended to use a light and well-drained substrate, ideally with 10% sand or perlite, and water every 3 or 4 days during the warm months, reducing the frequency to 1 or 2 times per week in winter, ensuring that the 1st 2-3 inches of soil are dry before watering again. An olive tree needs a minimum of 6 hours of direct sunlight daily to bear fruit and grow healthy, so its location is key. Pruning is done in late winter or early spring to shape it and remove dry or diseased branches, with a maximum of 5-6 main branches. In addition, fertilizing every 2 months during the growing season with a balanced fertilizer will keep it strong.

text_es: Cuidar mi olivo en maceta es una experiencia gratificante que comenzó hace 2 años, cuando me lo regalaron. Al principio, solo tenía 3 hojas, muy pequeñas, pero con paciencia y buen hacer ha ido creciendo. Cada 4 días lo riego con 1 litro de agua, y una vez al mes le añado un fertilizante especial para cítricos, siguiendo las instrucciones al pie de la letra, que indicaban 5 gotas por litro. Al principio me preocupaba el sol, pues vivo en un 7.º piso, pero le encanta estar expuesto a la luz directa durante al menos 6 horas. Podarlo es crucial para mantener su forma y estimular el crecimiento, retirando las ramas secas o enfermas con unas pequeñas tijeras. Verlo tan sano me llena de alegría, es como tener un trocito de Mediterráneo en mi salón.

text_en_raw: Caring for my potted olive tree is a rewarding experience that began 2 years ago, when it was given to me as a gift. At first, it only had 3 very small leaves, but with patience and good care it has been growing. Every 4 days I water it with 1 liter of water, and once a month I add a special fertilizer for citrus trees, following the instructions to the letter, which indicated 5 drops per liter. At first I was worried about the sun, since I live on the 7th floor, but it loves to be exposed to direct light for at least 6 hours. Pruning it is crucial to maintain its shape and stimulate growth, removing dry or diseased branches with small scissors. Seeing it so healthy fills me with joy, it's like having a little piece of the Mediterranean in my living room.

text_es: Para cuidar un olivo en maceta, elige una maceta con al menos 10 litros de capacidad y 2 a 3 agujeros de drenaje para evitar encharcamientos. Necesitará un sustrato bien drenado, mezclando tierra universal con 5 partes de arena gruesa y algo de perlita. Riega cuando los 3 a 5 cm superiores del sustrato estén secos al tacto; en verano, esto podría ser cada 2 o 3 días, mientras que en invierno cada 7 o 8 días será suficiente. Colócalo en un lugar con un mínimo de 6 horas de sol directo al día. Fertiliza con un abono específico para olivos cada 15 a 20 días durante la primavera y el verano. La poda se realizará a finales de invierno, eliminando las ramas secas o cruzadas para mantener su forma y vigor.

verify_en.notes: The translation uses digits for all cardinal numbers 2-20 (NAT style), which is correct and consistent throughout.

text_en_raw: To care for a potted olive tree, choose a pot with at least 10 liters of capacity and 2 to 3 drainage holes to prevent waterlogging. It will need a well-drained substrate, mixing universal soil with 5 parts coarse sand and some perlite. Water when the top 3 to 5 cm of the substrate are dry to the touch; in summer, this could be every 2 or 3 days, while in winter every 7 or 8 days will be enough. Place it in a spot with a minimum of 6 hours of direct sun per day. Fertilize with a specific fertilizer for olive trees every 15 to 20 days during spring and summer. Pruning will be done in late winter, removing dry or crossed branches to maintain its shape and vigor.

text_es: Preparar un examen de conducir implica una combinación de estudio teórico y práctica intensiva. Generalmente, el proceso se divide en 2 partes fundamentales: la teórica y la práctica. Para la prueba teórica, es crucial estudiar el manual de conducir, que aborda 8 secciones importantes como señales de tráfico, normas de circulación y 1.os auxilios, a menudo durante 3 o 4 semanas. Se recomienda realizar simulacros de examen en línea, donde se pueden encontrar más de 500 preguntas diferentes para practicar. La parte práctica exige clases con un instructor cualificado, realizando al menos 15 a 20 horas de conducción en diversas condiciones y con un mínimo de 6 maniobras básicas. Es fundamental mantener la calma y la concentración durante el examen, y muchos instructores sugieren un repaso final de 2 horas justo antes de la prueba.

verify_en.notes: The phrase '15 to 20 hours' violates NAT style by spelling out 'to' instead of using digit form; should be '15 to 20' or similar digit notation.

text_en_raw: Preparing for a driving test involves a combination of theoretical study and intensive practice. Generally, the process is divided into 2 fundamental parts: the theoretical and the practical. For the theoretical test, it's crucial to study the driving manual, which covers 8 important sections such as traffic signs, traffic laws, and 1st aid, often for 3 or 4 weeks. It's recommended to take online practice tests, where you can find more than 500 different questions to practice. The practical part requires classes with a qualified instructor, completing at least 15 to 20 hours of driving in various conditions and with a minimum of 6 basic maneuvers. It's essential to remain calm and focused during the test, and many instructors suggest a final 2-hour review just before the test.

text_es: Recuerdo perfectamente la intensidad de preparar mi examen de conducir hace ya 5 años. Dediqué al menos 2 horas diarias durante 3 semanas enteras a estudiar el manual de la autoescuela, con 12 capítulos densos sobre señales y normas. Mi profesor, un hombre de unos 50 años, me repetía constantemente que la clave estaba en la observación y la anticipación —daba 7 u 8 consejos de oro cada vez—. Practiqué con simulacros de examen unas 10 veces, y cada vez sentía más confianza, aunque los nervios siempre afloraban en los últimos 5 minutos antes de la prueba real. Aquel día, con solo 1 error en el teórico y una práctica impecable, lo conseguí.

text_es: Para preparar tu examen de conducir, dedica al menos 2 horas diarias al estudio del manual, comprendiendo las normas y señales de tráfico a fondo. Realiza 3 test de práctica al día durante 5 días seguidos para familiarizarte con el formato y el tipo de preguntas. Es fundamental practicar la conducción con un instructor experto; intenta tener 1 o 2 clases prácticas a la semana, centrándote en las maniobras y la circulación en diferentes entornos. No olvides revisar el mantenimiento básico del vehículo en 4 ocasiones, como los niveles de líquidos y la presión de los neumáticos, algo que puede aparecer en el examen. Descansa bien la noche anterior y llega al centro de exámenes con 15 minutos de antelación para evitar prisas innecesarias.

text_en_raw: To prepare for your driving test, dedicate at least 2 hours daily to studying the manual, thoroughly understanding traffic rules and signs. Take 3 practice tests a day for 5 consecutive days to familiarize yourself with the format and type of questions. It's essential to practice driving with an expert instructor; try to have 1 or 2 practical classes a week, focusing on maneuvers and driving in different environments. Don't forget to check basic vehicle maintenance on 4 occasions, such as fluid levels and tire pressure, something that may appear on the test. Rest well the night before and arrive at the testing center 15 minutes early to avoid unnecessary rushing.
